children: Daktronics entered into Amendment No. 1 to its Credit Agreement to allow the transfer of certain non-material patents at less than 75% of fair market value. The amendment, effective September 1, 2026, modifies the November 26, 2025 Credit Agreement with JPMorgan as agent and the lending group. The change facilitates transfers tied to the company’s prior acquisition of a display business from X Display Company Technology, providing added flexibility under the facility.
: JPMorgan Chase Bank, as Agent, and other lenders
: Enable transfer of certain patents below 75% of fair value
